issue_text: Hi, I want to start with my shopping account. Please tell me what promotions are currently active, then check whether code FALL15SAVE would work with my current cart. After that, pull up my customer account and confirm the email, tier, loyalty points, and purchase history you see.
summary: This cross-skill session has the grok-build agent handle shopping promos, an airline reservation baggage change, a new flight booking, a product exchange, and a hotel cancellation across several identities. It opens with a misstep: unable to resolve the default shopping user, the agent guesses Maya Chen, and when the user corrects it ('that's not my account') it apologizes and redoes everything for the real account, Evan Parker. It then repeatedly patches a strict Pydantic model to load airline data, adds a bag to Olivia Bennett's D3A184, books Megan Carter's LAX→LAS flight, previews and confirms an exchange ($6 store credit), and cancels Elena Brooks' hotel HR-68D9 for a full $298 refund. Four recall traps (T2, T5, T9, T10) re-ask the corrected account, Olivia's updated reservation, the exchange outcome, and Megan's booking; the agent handles the first as a clean self-correction and the rest from accurate memory. The cell resolves cleanly with a consistent five-item recap.
